name: gated_rgb_control_v2
purpose: Learn stable real RGB closed-loop PTZ control before advancing difficulty

control_execution.note: P-DQN author core retained in a separate profile; these calibrated bounds/rates are explicit changes

frozen_frontend.reid: existing verified FastReID VeRi SBS R50-IBN 2048-dim

seed_policy.final_test_materialization: blocked by default; only explicit final release after all current gates pass
seed_policy.old_cases: Prior training, validation and diagnosed40000-series tests are not new held-out tests
seed_policy.validation_use: Fixed held-out seeds for declared stage gating/model selection, never gradients
seed_policy.test_use: Single frozen release after all gates; failures become diagnostic and require a new future test partition

progression.advance_only_if: current stage validation gate passes and all earlier-stage regression gates pass
progression.checkpoint_selection: validation gate evidence, never final-test results
progression.new_stage_initialization: continue best validation-qualified learned policy; record any optimizer/replay/reset explicitly
progression.failed_stage: remain at current difficulty, diagnose before rerun; do not mark later stages started
progression.regression: stop and restore last qualified checkpoint, preserve failed attempt
progression.note: Budget exhaustion is not a passing gate; these are stop/review budgets, not automatic promotion points

metric_contract.center_error: sqrt((2*cx-1)^2+(2*cy-1)^2), computed from the selected RGB detection
metric_contract.scale_log_error: abs(log(area_ratio/0.04)); unavailable detections do not become zeros
metric_contract.availability: time-weighted valid selected detections and separate offline correct-GT matching coverage
metric_contract.offline_gt: identity/false-positive and visibility diagnostics only; cannot influence state/action/reward or reset aiming
metric_contract.stable_hold: entire required hold window after settling, not only one terminal frame; every action-end RGB observation logged
metric_contract.loss_run_seconds: sum of action durations during consecutive unavailable selected detections
metric_contract.rapid_unwarranted_reversal: opposite same-axis commands <=0.5s apart while preceding observed axis error<=0.03, followed by error worsening>=0.02
metric_contract.total_direction_reversals: sum of opposite nonzero commands on the same pan/tilt/zoom axis; Stay and other-axis commands do not erase the preceding command; normalized per10 actual simulation seconds
metric_contract.settling_time: first time after which the complete required stable-hold window meets center/scale bounds
metric_contract.oscillation_note: Necessary direction changes during actual motion are not automatically counted as unstable reversals
metric_contract.confidence: confidence alone is never a task-success criterion; detector threshold remains frozen
metric_contract.sampling_limit: metrics summarize actual closed-loop action-end RGB samples; no claim of continuous pixel truth between samples

stages.gate_note: At least38/40 pass and each offset quadrant at least9/10; no validation seeds omitted

stages.occlusion_metric_note: Exclude only externally verified actual occlusion from unintended-loss denominator; center-clear ray alone is insufficient

stages.lighting_note: UE directional/sky/exposure controls, not a calibrated physical lux guarantee
